+import os
+import time
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE = "https://api.assemblyai.com/v2"
+
+
+def _headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return {"authorization": api_key, "content-type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def _get_json(url: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    response = requests.get(url, headers=_headers(), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def poll_transcription(transcript_id: str, interval: float = 2.0, timeout: Optional[float] = 300.0) -> str:
+    deadline = None if timeout is None else time.time() + timeout
+    url = f"{ASSEMBLYAI_API_BASE}/transcript/{transcript_id}"
+    while True:
+        data = _get_json(url)
+        status = data.get("status")
+        if status == "completed":
+            transcript = data.get("text")
+            if transcript is None:
+                raise RuntimeError("Transcript completed but no text was returned")
+            return transcript
+        if status == "error":
+            raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "Transcription failed"))
+        if deadline is not None and time.time() > deadline:
+            raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for transcription to complete")
+        time.sleep(interval)
+
*** End Patch

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import mimetypes
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import error, request
+
+
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL = os.environ.get("OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe")
+
+
+def submit_batch_transcription(audio_path: str) -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
+        audio_bytes = f.read()
+
+    mime_type = mimetypes.guess_type(audio_path)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "type": "input_audio",
+                "audio": base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode("ascii"),
+                "format": mime_type,
+                "filename": os.path.basename(audio_path),
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    req = request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with request.urlopen(req, timeout=300) as resp:
+            return json.load(resp)
+    except error.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI API error {exc.code}: {body}") from exc
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    result = submit_batch_transcription(args.audio_file)
+    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
